title: Alchemist (formerly Alchemist Accelerator)
deadline_note: No deadline or cohort date is published. The 'Pitch us' founder form was live and accepting input on 2026-11-24; Alchemist says its support 'does not run on a set program length'.
amount: Investment check of $60,000 to $1 million at pre-seed/seed ('depending on the company and the program'); equity terms are not published on the site

summary.at_a_glance: Alchemist (the former Alchemist Accelerator; alchemistaccelerator.com now redirects to alchemist.vc) describes itself as an early-stage venture firm, no longer an accelerator. It invests at pre-seed and seed in deeply technical teams building for the enterprise (B2B) and then supports them through its 'Founder experience'. Founders apply by filling in a single public 'Pitch us' form.
summary.what_they_offer: A check of $60,000 to $1 million, plus the Founder experience: a Founder Plan built on an onboarding call, a Success Manager, an equity-aligned Alchemist Partner (operator) matched to the company for the first year, sales training and a sales coach for six months, fundraising support (Investor Feedback Summits, workshops, two Investor Showcases a year in Silicon Valley), the Vault network of 40,000 mentors, over $500K in perks, a desk in the San Francisco office for six months if based in Silicon Valley, and community events including an annual Founder Retreat in January.
summary.what_theyre_looking_for: Official wording: 'Deeply technical researchers, engineers and domain experts building the next generation of enterprise infrastructure and technology.' A strong fit: (1) 'You are a builder' who knows the technology deeply; (2) 'Your customers are businesses' and the sale is complex; (3) 'You are ready to commercialize, and to get in front of customers now'; (4) 'You want support beyond the check'. Sector agnostic (AI is the largest field; health is listed among portfolio sectors). An 'enterprise startup' is defined as B2B and B2B2C, hardware or software, buyers from SMB to Fortune 500, license/SaaS/usage-based models.
summary.who_can_apply: Pre-seed and seed companies from any country ('our investment structure works with your country of incorporation'). No warm introduction needed. Solo founders are accepted but 'it is a higher bar'; most Alchemist companies start with two or three co-founders. The form accepts companies that are not yet incorporated. No relocation to San Francisco required.
summary.how_to_apply: 1) Open https://www.alchemist.vc/pitch (embeds the Fillout form; direct link https://forms.fillout.com/t/59MdaHhiDius). 2) Complete the one-page application (three collapsible sections: Company & Team Details; Product, Market & Traction; Other Information). 3) Click Next to reach a Review page, then Submit. The form 'goes straight to our investment team'. Later stages (interviews, decision timing) are not described on the official site.
summary.worth_noting: The firm states it backs B2B businesses (B2B and B2B2C); a purely consumer product is outside the stated focus. The pitch deck and the optional team video are requested as links, not uploads. The form certifies truthfulness by typed initials. Regional programs (Alchemist Chicago, Doha, Japan) exist; the FAQ says to request them through the same form, but the opt-in switches for those programs are currently hidden in the published form. The old third-party applyseed.com page is not the application.

portal.platform: Fillout (forms.fillout.com), embedded in an iframe on alchemist.vc/pitch
portal.notes: No account needed. The whole application is one long page with three collapsible sections, then a Review step and a Submit button. Cloudflare Turnstile is loaded by the form page (challenge requests were observed on page load), so a bot check may run at submit. Phone fields have a country selector defaulting to US. The address widget has sub-fields: Address, Address Line 2 (Optional), City, State / Province, ZIP / Postal code, Country. Pitch deck and video must be reachable links that are not password-protected. Several fields only appear depending on earlier answers (see questions_note). The form's own page offers a direct link ('Form not loading? Open it in a new tab'): https://forms.fillout.com/t/59MdaHhiDius.

questions_note: Taken from the live official form on 2026-11-24: the published form definition embedded in the Fillout page (labels, required flags, options, limits, show/hide rules) and cross-checked against the rendered form in a headless browser. Nothing was typed or submitted. High confidence. Long-answer fields show a character counter but have no maximum; the only limit is 280 characters on the company description.
